comments.author: Best way 2 lvl Handi
comments.body:
The best way and also most efficient way cost efficient way to lvl handicraft after rank 10 is not these stupid gems or sherry it's boot making.
Boot making requires 10 vegetable oil and 10 leather per improve the vegetable oil cost about 50 each and it takes roughly 500 or 25mil worth of vegetable oil to make a 100 defense boots which you can then sell for 100 mil each which will give you enough money to buy even more veg oil to make more boots. Even if you have horrible luck crafting you can sell 60-70 defense boots for 25-40 mil making up for the initial loss of 25 mil for the 500 vegetable oil

Each improve gives roughly 10-20 proficiency points each time which is awesome! So you can make money while you grind. Trust me make boots it's the best way

comments.author: Erda
comments.body:
Gems are certainly faster than sherry past r14 (or 12+2), if you do it right ; which means both land activity oxford skills turned on, and in a good landing point (for instance ceylon, where the ratio ores/other junk is high).

The drawback of Ceylon is that you will get small exp/fame from selling as it's in india and less profit from saphire/rubies, but it's the fastest.

Boot making is an entirely other beast. I am quite sure you will lose money if you start doing it at r10, even with all 5 oxford (4 GS + item improvement) and aide on paymaster 100. Remember that although a higher rank in handicrafts does not change the probability of GS it does improve the bump to defense per success. I have not tried doing this for grinding, so I cannot tell how it fares exp-wise, but money-wise it's a bad calculation at least under r13-14.
